gloss: the decisive word of an authority figure

definitions.gloss: the decisive word of an authority figure
definitions.explanation: Literally 'one call of the crane.' A single word from a powerful person that settles a matter others had been arguing over.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{鶴|つる}の{一声|ひとこえ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{決|き}まった→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧。
examples.english: It was settled by a single word from the president.

examples.japanese: ⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{長引|ながび}いた→長引く：14473_nagabiku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{部長|ぶちょう}→部長：01017_buchou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{鶴|つる}の{一声|ひとこえ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{終|お}わった。
examples.english: The discussion dragged on until one word from the department head ended it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{反対意見|はんたいいけん}→反対意見：24246_hantaiiken⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{多|おお}かった→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{会長|かいちょう}→会長：11610_kaichou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{鶴|つる}の{一声|ひとこえ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{中止|ちゅうし}→中止：03481_chuushi⟧になった。
examples.english: There was plenty of opposition, but the chairman's word was enough to cancel the plan.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
The crane's loud call silences all the other birds. The fuller saying contrasts it with ⟦{雀|すずめ}→雀：05006_suzume⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{千声|せんこえ}, a thousand chirps from sparrows.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- X⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{鶴|つる}の{一声|ひとこえ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{決|き}まる→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧: to be decided by X's word

USAGE:
Common about companies, families and politics. It can carry a hint of criticism that the decision bypassed discussion.
